name_reason: Follows the DPMI naming convention fd2_dpmi_*. Descriptor 'lock_size' accurately distinguishes this size-based wrapper (takes base + size) from fd2_dpmi_lock_region (takes start + end). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Size-based convenience wrapper that locks a DPMI linear-memory region given a base address and a byte size, by computing end = base + size and delegating to fd2_dpmi_lock_region.
logic_summary: Tail-wrapper: returns fd2_dpmi_lock_region(base, base + size). Disassembly: MOV EAX,[ESP+4] (base); ADD EAX,[ESP+8] (base+size=end) then PUSH (arg2=end); MOV EBX,[ESP+8] (base, after first push=arg1=start) then PUSH; CALL fd2_dpmi_lock_region; ADD ESP,8; RET. EAX (lock_region's CF result) flows straight through to RET.

params.name: base
params.semantics: Base linear byte address of the region to lock; passed as lock_region's start argument.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches body usage (start of region), no address residue.

params.name: size
params.semantics: Size of the region in bytes; end address computed as base + size and passed as lock_region's end argument.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches body usage (region byte size), no address residue.

returns.semantics: Pass-through of fd2_dpmi_lock_region's result: 1 on success (DPMI CF clear), 0 on failure. Tail-call leaves the callee's EAX intact at RET. Ghidra decompiles as void only because no current caller consumes the value.

notes: Return-type nuance: Ghidra plate/decompile said 'void return'; the assembly is a tail-wrapper (CALL fd2_dpmi_lock_region; ADD ESP,8; RET) so EAX carries lock_region's CF result through to RET. The src correctly declares 'int' and returns the call result -- consistent with the asm. Updated the Ghidra plate to fix the inaccurate 'void return' note (now documents the EAX pass-through); src comment was already concise+correct so kept it (no Edit to dpmi.c). No global reads/writes. No logic issues.
